user_story: As a user, I want to see tooltips with information about elements when I hover over them, so that I can understand their functionality better. Acceptance Criteria: When I hover over the input field with id 'toolTipTextField', a tooltip should appear with the text 'You hovered over the Text Field'. When I hover over the button with id 'toolTipButton', a tooltip should appear with the text 'You hovered over the Button'.
